decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) are close to the core polishing and coating know-how and serve growing 3D-integration and high-frequency markets, and the firm is growing with slack, so no performance shortfall triggers a search for other uses of the resources, although the product is less prominent on the website in 2024.

VLIS was launched in 2024 with its own dedicated page as a next-generation technology that fits the strategy of moving into higher-value proprietary products, and growth gives the firm enough slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain.
